title: FBI-UAP-D023, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-7, Western United States Event, 2023

pages.description: A dark nighttime desert scene showing two silhouetted human figures standing on a dirt road facing away from the viewer toward a range of mountains under a deep blue sky. Five glowing red-orange lights are arranged in a curved arc in the sky above the mountain ridge. In the lower left corner is the partial silhouette of a car with a reflective metallic surface. Two pairs of small white lights (resembling headlights) are visible in the mid-ground at the base of the mountains. The terrain is barren and rocky, with a winding pale dirt path leading into the distance. There is faint semi-transparent watermark text near the right-center of the image.

observations.claim: Two silhouetted human figures stand facing away from the camera
Five red-orange glowing lights form an arc in the sky above a mountain range
A partial car silhouette occupies the lower left corner
Two pairs of small white lights appear at the base of the mountains
A faint watermark is present near the right-center of the image
The scene depicts a barren desert with a winding dirt path
